newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Aussie Home Loans cuts fixed rate mortgages.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Aussie Home Loans cuts fixed rate mortgages.

text.p: Australia's biggest non-bank mortgage lender, Aussie Home Loans, said on Thursday it would cut its fixed home loan interest rates after Wednesday's 0.5 percentage point cut in official cash interest rates.

Aussie Home Loans said it had already cuts its variable rate to 7.99 percent on October 28, in anticipation of the official rate reduction. "The new standard variable rate has resulted in Aussie Home lonas posting record new landing for the month of November, with expectations that new loans written for the month will reach more than A$300 million," Aussie Home Loans said.
The new rates range from 7.99 percent for one year (from 8.6 percent) to 8.75 percent (from 8.95 percent) for five years.
